import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX = 1 << 20;
    static int n, limit, result;
    static int[] p1_array = new int[MAX];
    static int[] p2_array = new int[MAX];
    static int[][] flag_grid = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] a_grid = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] h_array = new int[10][10][10];

    static int fast_pow(int base, int exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (int) ((long) res * base % MOD);
            base = (int) ((long) base * base % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int modular_inverse(int x) {
        return fast_pow(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static boolean check_triplet(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] arr = {x, y, z};
        int[] d = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            if (flag_grid[arr[d[0]]][1] != 0 && flag_grid[arr[d[1]]][2] != 0 && flag_grid[arr[d[2]]][3] != 0)
                return true;
        } while (next_permutation(d));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean next_permutation(int[] d) {
        int i = d.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && d[i] >= d[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = d.length - 1;
        while (d[j] <= d[i]) j--;
        swap(d, i, j);
        reverse(d, i + 1, d.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] d, int i, int j) {
        int temp = d[i];
        d[i] = d[j];
        d[j] = temp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] d, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            swap(d, start, end);
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }

    static void explore_first(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 1) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check_triplet(i, j, k)) {
                            int X = 1;
                            while (X == i || X == j || X == k) X++;
                            int Y = X + 1;
                            while (Y == i || Y == j || Y == k) Y++;
                            int Z = Y + 1;
                            while (Z == i || Z == j || Z == k) Z++;
                            state |= h_array[X][Y][Z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            p1_array[state] = (p1_array[state] + P) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        flag_grid[x][y] = 1;
        if (y == 3) {
            explore_first((int) ((long) P * a_grid[x][y] % MOD), x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            explore_first((int) ((long) P * a_grid[x][y] % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
        flag_grid[x][y] = 0;
        if (y == 3) {
            explore_first((int) ((long) P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y]) % MOD), x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            explore_first((int) ((long) P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y]) % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    static void explore_second(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 4) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check_triplet(i, j, k))
                            state |= h_array[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            p2_array[state] = (p2_array[state] + P) % MOD;
            result = (int) ((MOD + 1 - result + (long) p1_array[limit ^ state] * P % MOD) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        flag_grid[x][y - 3] = 1;
        if (y == 6) {
            explore_second((int) ((long) P * a_grid[x][y] % MOD), x + 1, 4);
        } else {
            explore_second((int) ((long) P * a_grid[x][y] % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
        flag_grid[x][y - 3] = 0;
        if (y == 6) {
            explore_second((int) ((long) P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y]) % MOD), x + 1, 4);
        } else {
            explore_second((int) ((long) P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y]) % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                int val = sc.nextInt();
                a_grid[i][j] = (int) ((long) val * modular_inverse(100) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            a_grid[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    h_array[i][j][k] = 1 << total++;
                }
            }
        }
        explore_first(1, 1, 1);
        limit = MAX - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= limit; j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    p1_array[j] = (p1_array[j] + p1_array[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        explore_second(1, 1, 4);
        result = (MOD + 1 - result) % MOD;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
